mods.name: Raft World
mods.description:
Start on a tiny raft in an endless ocean. Survive and rebuild the world.

Official website: https://raft.wilkcraft.work/

releases.notes:
# 📌 Version 1.5.1
> 🌋 Nether Update — mine deeper, craft further, and finally reach the Nether

## ✨ New Features
* 📈 Expanded the **Progression System** with new stages and rewards — more ores, materials and items to unlock as you progress
* 🌋 You can now build a **Nether Portal** and travel to the Nether from your raft
* 🌐 Added **Korean (ko_kr)** language support
* 🎣 Starting fishing rod now begins to take durability damage from **Stage 4** onward
* 🦈 Rebalanced **Raft Shark** attributes

---

## 📈 Progression System
New stages and advancements have been added leading up to being **Nether Ready**, unlocking new tiers of ores, tools and materials as you progress. The full breakdown of every stage and its rewards is available at **[raft.wilkcraft.work/progression.html](https://raft.wilkcraft.work/progression.html)**.

In short: keep surviving and upgrading your gear, and you'll gradually get access to better minerals and items — all the way up to what you need to open a portal.

---

## 🌋 The Nether
* Once you've gathered enough **Obsidian** and crafted a **Flint and Steel**, you can now build and light a Nether Portal from your raft
* Entering a Nether portal **from the Nether** will return you to Raft World — if there isn't already a nearby portal, one will be generated for you, with the portal placed at **Y=90** and you arriving at **Y=91**
* Returning from the Nether will place you at the equivalent coordinates you'd arrive at in the Overworld, keeping travel consistent with vanilla portal linking

---

## 🌐 Language Support
* Added **Korean (ko_kr)** translation, contributed by **StrawberrySushi_ (Kakaka999)** via a GitHub pull request — thank you! 🙏

---

## 🎣 Gameplay Changes
* Starting **unbreakable** fishing rod loses its unbreakable status once you reach **Stage 4** and begins taking normal durability damage — by this point you should have the resources to craft replacements
* 🦈 **Raft Shark** attributes updated:
  * Max Health: **28.0**
  * Attack Damage: **5.0**
  * Movement Speed: **1.6**

---

## ⚙️ Technical Changes
* 📊 Expanded progression manager with new stage thresholds and unlock conditions
* 🏆 Added new advancements tied to the new progression stages
* 🌋 Implemented Nether ↔ Raft World dimension redirect handling, including automatic portal generation on arrival
* 🎣 Added stage-gated logic to strip the starting fishing rod's unbreakable tag
* 🦈 Updated `RaftSharkEntity` attribute values
* 🌐 Added `ko_kr` translation file

---

From tiny raft to Nether-ready survivor — the ocean was just the beginning 🌋

releases.notes:
# 📌 Version 1.4.6
> 🏝️ Landfall — the endless ocean now hides islands worth finding, worth mining, and worth defending
 
## ✨ New Features
* 🏝️ Added three island sizes: **small**, **medium**, and **large**
* ⛏️ Islands can now generate **iron** and **coal ore**
* 🧭 Added the **/nearestisland** command to locate the closest island
* 🧟 Islands can now spawn **hostile mobs** at night
---
 
## 🏝️ Islands
* 🟢 **Small**
* 🟡 **Medium**
* 🔴 **Large**
---
 
## ⛏️ Ores
Island rock can now hide ore, hidden among the stone.
 
| Ore | Chance per stone block |
|---|---|
| Iron Ore | ~0.45% (1 in 220) |
| Coal Ore | ~1.36% (3 in 220) |
 
---
 
## 🧭 /nearestisland Command
* `/nearestisland` — nearest island of any size
* `/nearestisland small` / `medium` / `large` — nearest island of that size
* Returns a clickable teleport link
**Access:**
* ✅ Always available in **Creative** and **Spectator**
* 🔐 In **Survival** and **Adventure**, only with **cheats enabled**
---
 
## 🧟 Hostile Mobs on Islands
| Setting | Value |
|---|---|
| Check interval | every 40 ticks (2s) |
| Search radius | 40 blocks around player |
| Max light level | 7 |
| Min. distance from player | 6 blocks |
| Spawn attempts per check | 4 |
| Max hostiles near player | 8 |
| Vertical search range | Y 85 – Y 112 |
 
**Mob odds:**
 
| Mob | Weight |
|---|---|
|  Zombie | 55 |
| Skeleton | 30 |
| Spider | 30 |
| Creeper | 20 |
 
---
 
## ⚙️ Technical Changes
* 🏝️ Added small/medium/large island size categories to world generation
* ⛏️ Added weighted iron/coal ore rolls to island stone generation
* 🧭 Added /nearestisland command with small/medium/large subcommands and a teleport link
* 🔐 Restricted /nearestisland to Creative/Spectator, or Survival/Adventure with cheats enabled
* 🧟 Added a dedicated hostile mob spawner for islands, independent of the ocean biome's natural spawn list
* 🎯 Implemented weighted mob selection and light/distance-based spawn gating
---
 
The ocean isn't as empty as it looks — and neither are its islands. 🏝️

releases.notes:
# 📌 Version 1.4.2

> 🦈 Into the Deep — diamonds now await in the depths, but the ocean has gained a new apex predator

## ✨ New Features

* 🦈 Added **Sharks**, a dangerous new hostile ocean mob
* 💎 Expanded **Stage 6** progression with underwater diamond generation
* 🌊 Improved deep-ocean exploration with a new risk versus reward experience

---

## 📈 Progression System

Complete objectives to unlock new loot tiers.

### 🌊 Stage 6 — Into the Depths

**Objective:** Dive **10 blocks deep wearing a turtle helmet**

**Unlocked Loot**

* Potion of Water Breathing (03:00)

**New in 1.4.2**

* 💎 Diamonds now generate between **Y 60 and Y 70**

---

## 🦈 Sharks

A new hostile ocean predator has been added.

### 🌊 Spawning

* Spawn naturally between **Y 60 and Y 80**
* Spawn in groups of **1–3 sharks**

### ⚔️ Behavior

* Once a shark spots a player, it begins pursuing them
* Nearby sharks are alerted and join the hunt
* Sharks continue following their target even after losing direct sight
* If the player leaves the water, sharks circle nearby for **30 seconds**
* After that, they lose interest and swim away
* They cannot target the same player again until **20 seconds** have passed and they spot the player once more
* Sharks eat any dropped item they pick up after **3 seconds**

### 📊 Attributes

* ❤️ **Health:** 16 (8 hearts)
* 🗡️ **Attack Damage:** 2.5
* 🏃 **Movement Speed:** 1.3
* 👀 **Follow Range:** 24 blocks

---

## 🌍 Gameplay

* 💎 Diamonds can now be obtained by progressing into the deepest ocean layers.
* 🦈 Exploring those depths is now much more dangerous, as sharks actively hunt nearby players.

---

## ⚙️ Technical Changes

* 💎 Added diamond generation between **Y 60–70** after reaching **Stage 6**
* 🦈 Added shark spawning between **Y 60–80** with group spawning support
* 🎯 Implemented coordinated shark alert and pursuit AI
* ⏳ Added persistence and cooldown logic for shark targeting
* 🍖 Implemented dropped-item consumption behavior

---

The deepest waters now hold the greatest treasures... and their deadliest guardians. 🦈

releases.notes:
# 📌 Version 1.3.8
> 🌙 Bugfix Update — the sun finally rises over the raft

## 🐛 Bug Fixes
* 🌙 Fixed a bug where sleeping in a bed inside the **Raft dimension** would never turn night into day
* ⏰ The in-game clock is now correctly synced when waking up from sleep in `raftworld:raft`

---

## 🌍 Gameplay
* 🛏️ Sleeping in the Raft dimension now properly skips the night, just like in the Overworld

---

## ⚙️ Technical Changes
* 🌙 Added a dedicated sleep handler that forces the day/night cycle to advance correctly from non-Overworld dimensions
* 🔧 Fixed an issue where the day/night clock in `raftworld:raft` could not be updated directly, since it mirrors the Overworld's time data

---

No more endless nights adrift — sleep tight, wake up to the sunrise 🌅

releases.notes:
# 📌 Version 1.3.3

> 📈 Progression Update — unlock new floating loot as you survive and expand your raft

## ✨ New Features

* 📈 Added a **Progression System** that unlocks new floating loot by completing objectives
* 🏆 Added a complete set of **advancements** to guide progression through the mod
* 🌍 Improved the **Raft** dimension so hostile mobs can no longer naturally spawn unless they spawn **in water**
* 🌐 Added **Spanish (Spain)** (`es_es`) language translations

## 📈 Progression System

Complete objectives to unlock new loot tiers.

### 🌱 Stage 0 — Base

Available from the start.

**Unlocked Loot**

* Dirt, Oak Planks, Stick, Rotten Flesh, String, Oak Sapling

### 📦 Stage 1 — Raft Net

**Objective:** Build a **Raft Net**

**Unlocked Loot**

* Wheat Seeds, Potato, Carrot

### ⛏️ Stage 2 — Farming

**Objective:** Obtain **10 Wheat** and a **Wooden Hoe**

**Unlocked Loot**

* Cobblestone, Coal, Raw Iron, Iron Nugget

### 🪓 Stage 3 — Stone Age

**Objective:** Obtain a **Stone Pickaxe** and **Stone Axe**

**Unlocked Loot**

* Flint, Clay Ball, Cod, Salmon

### 🔥 Stage 4 — Iron Age

**Objective:** Smelt **5 Iron Ingots**

**Unlocked Loot**

* Redstone, Lapis Lazuli, Copper Ingot, Gold Nugget

## 🏆 New Advancements

* 🌍 **Raft World** — Survive the endless ocean *(Unlocked upon entering the Raft dimension)*
* 🟫 **Catching Everything** — Build a **Raft Net**
* 🌾 **Green Thumb** — Obtain **10 Wheat** and a **Wooden Hoe**
* 🪨 **Rock Solid** — Obtain a **Stone Pickaxe** and **Stone Axe**
* 🔥 **Blast Furnace Beginner** — Smelt **5 Iron Ingots**

## 🌊 Floating Loot

Floating loot now expands as you progress.

### ⚡ Fast Items

The first **10 spawned items** move toward the player much faster.

**Tag:** `raftworld_fast`

## 🌍 Gameplay

* 🚫 Hostile mobs no longer naturally spawn in the **Raft** dimension unless their spawn location is **in water**
* 📈 Floating loot progression provides a more natural survival experience and gradual access to resources

## ⚙️ Technical Changes

* 📊 Added a progression manager for unlocking loot stages
* 🏆 Added new advancements for each progression milestone
* 🌊 Updated loot spawning to respect unlocked progression stages
* 🌐 Added complete **Spanish (Spain)** localization (`es_es`)

---

A better survival journey, one floating reward at a time 🌊📈
